'''Mrissi''' (singular '''Mriss''') were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mrisst/Legends|Mrisst]] in the [[Mrisst system/Legends|Mrisst system]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Mrissi evolved from flightless birds, and retained a light covering of feathers,<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" /> hollow bones<ref name="The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>, and vestigial wings on their shoulders. They were a small people, less than half a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall on average.<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />

==Society and culture==
The Mrissi were renowned throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as scholars. They also displayed a tendency to break from the political mainstream, and felt free to express their opinions despite what others may think.

==History==
During the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Mrissi were warned that the heightened levels of air pollution on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] were dangerous to their species. They were susceptible to diseases caused by the pollution, such as [[lungrot]], [[dioxo-brionchiectasis shock]], [[silicalung]] and [[hemorrhagic molting]].

During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Mrisst had several universities which, while not as prestigious as more expensive schools, enjoyed an excellent galactic reputation. It was these schools which brought Imperial forces to Mrisst to subdue the sometimes radical, but peaceful, political views of the Mrissi.<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />

During the period of Imperial subjugation, many Mrissi left their homeworld as refugees or wandering scholars. Others were forced to use their knowledge to serve the Empire. Soon after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Mrissi began to enthusiastically support the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />

Despite their intelligence, the Mrissi had an unusual cultural blind spot. Until contacted by the [[Tenth Alderaanian Expedition]], they had never developed the art of sculpture. [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] used this quirk as a starting point to better understand Mriss psychology, leading to the seizure of Mrisst shortly before his [[siege of Coruscant]].<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mrissi should not be confused with the [[Mrlssi]] of [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]], in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], who were also a small, scholarly race of flightless birds.<ref name="Alien Encounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
